# Alagna.it

> > Official tourism portal for Alagna Valsesia and Monte Rosa, featuring world-class freeride skiing, mountaineering to Capanna Margherita (Europe's highest refuge at 4554m), and Walser cultural heritage in the Italian Alps.

Operated by Lyskamm Viaggi with 22+ years of experience, this site serves as the comprehensive guide to Alagna and the Monterosaski area, offering holiday packages, IFMGA-certified mountain guides, and detailed information on ski touring, heliskiing, trekking routes, and alpine adventures across the Valsesia region.

## Key Topics

- Monte Rosa
- Alagna Valsesia
- Capanna Margherita (4554m)
- Monterosaski
- Freeride skiing
- Ski touring & ski mountaineering
- Walser culture
- IFMGA mountain guides
- Heliskiing
- Mountaineering & alpine climbing
- Gressoney
- Riva Valdobbia
- Punta Giordani
- Signal Ridge
- Acclimatization for high altitude

## Getting Started

- [Vacanze Valsesia e Vacanze Monte Rosa - Alagna.it](https://alagna.it/en/home-page): English homepage for Alagna tourism with Monte Rosa holiday packages
- [Alagna SKI - Your Holidays in Valsesia and Monterosa - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en): English site homepage featuring freeride paradise & Walser traditions
- [Who we are - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/who-are-we): About Alagna.it & Lyskamm Viaggi: 22 years of custom Val Sesia holidays
- [Tourist Office of Alagna - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/tourist-office): ATL Valsesia tourist office contact info & opening hours in P.za Grober
- [F.A.Q. - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/faq): FAQ: trekking routes, weather, parking, cable cars & Val d'Otro info

## Winter Sports & Freeride

- [Experiences - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/experiences): Main activities page: freeride, Monterosaski, trekking & mountaineering
- [Ski Touring Italy in the Monterosa ski - Alagna.it](https://alagna.it/en/experiences/ski-touring-italy-monterosaski): Ski touring guide: Zube pass, Giordani peak & Soldato's ridge routes
- [Heliski day - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/holiday-packages-alagna/heliski-day): Single-day heliskiing package in Alta Valsesia natural park (from €430)
- [Don't forget your safety - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/freeride-alagna-monterosa/dont-forget-your-safety): Freeride safety guide: ARVA equipment, avalanche risks & procedures
- [Alagna Impianti risalita. Situazione piste e impianti - Alagna.it](https://alagna.it/situazione-piste-e-impianti): Live ski lift status & piste conditions for Valsesia Impianti
- [Special offers and promotions - save up to 15%](https://alagna.it/en/special-offers): Special deals & promotions: Monte Rosa ski touring, Gran Paradiso packages

## Mountaineering & High Altitude

- [Capanna Margherita mountain hut 4554 m - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/experiences/monterosa-mountaineering/regina-margherita-mountain-hut): Europe's highest refuge: Capanna Margherita at 4554m on Monte Rosa
- [how to acclimatise for Capanna Margherita](https://alagna.it/en/how-to-acclimatise-for-capanna-margherita): Acclimatization strategy for Capanna Margherita climb preparation
- [altitude sickness and acclimatisation](https://alagna.it/en/blog/altitude-sickness-acclimatisation): Altitude sickness prevention: 3 mountain huts for Monte Rosa preparation
- [acclimatization.. Take it easy! - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/blog/acclimatamento-take-it-easy): High altitude acclimatization tips for Monte Rosa & Capanna Margherita
- [Scuola d'Alpinismo del corpo Guide Alagna - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/scuola-alpinismo-guide-alagna): Alagna Alpine School: mountaineering courses & guided climbing packages

## Hiking & Trekking Routes

- [The Olen Valley - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/routes-walks-trekking-monterosa/the-olen-valley): Trail 205D through Olen Valley to Col d'Olen & Vigevano mountain hut
- [Riva Valdobbia - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/snowshoes-itineraries/riva-valdobbia): Easy snowshoe route from Alagna to Riva Valdobbia via Sesia river
- [The mills of Uterio - Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/routes-walks-trekking-monterosa/the-mills-of-uterio): Easy walk to Uterio hamlet's working historic mills & Walser museum
- [rock climbing Alagna](https://alagna.it/en/blog/alagna-rock-climbing-guide-where-adventure-meets-altitude): Beginner's rock climbing guide for Alagna: gear, techniques & local crags
